headline: Nigeria EFCC Recovers Additional $40M From Nestoil in Debt Probe
summary: Nigeria's Economic and Financial Crimes Commission recovered an additional $40 million from Nestoil Limited under an ongoing debt investigation involving Neconde Energy and bank lenders, bringing total recoveries to $100 million.
why: Recoveries by Nigeria's EFCC highlight sovereign and financial sector efforts to resolve non-performing upstream oil loans and stabilize domestic commercial bank balances.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Debt recoveries return liquidity to domestic bank syndicates that funded upstream energy assets.
